data.adjudication: Official corrective action; committee closed the matter after repayment and compliance measures.
data.claim: The House Ethics Committee reviewed allegations involving outside earned income, endorsements, and company roles; it required Mullin to repay $40,000 that had been paid in error and then closed the matter.
